question: What Settings localization contract should OpenClaw support for schema/uiHint-derived config labels, and how should the two open partial PRs be sequenced?
rationale: UI chrome can use the existing generated locale pipeline, but schema-derived labels cross the config/schema and frontend i18n boundary, and the open PRs already overlap generated outputs.

options.title: Define One Settings I18n Contract
options.body: Sponsor one key/fallback design for Settings chrome plus schema labels, then have contributors or ClawSweeper rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

options.title: Land Low-Risk Chrome Slices First
options.body: Accept toolbar or Quick Settings localization first while keeping this issue open for schema-derived labels as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Defer Schema Label Localization
options.body: Keep schema-derived labels English for now and narrow this issue to fixed, non-schema Settings UI chrome only.

recommendation.title: Define One Settings I18n Contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor one key/fallback design for Settings chrome plus schema labels, then have contributors or ClawSweeper rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current-main routing signal across the Settings files and the generated i18n source surface.
